title: jeen-yuhs: A Kanye Trilogy
description: Three-part documentary series on Netflix, directed by Coodie & Chike, detailing the life of Kanye from the perspective of Coodie. "Act I: Vision" follows Kanye before The College Dropout as he was trying to get signed to a record deal. "Act II: Purpose" details Kanye's car accident, the making of The College Dropout, and Kanye finally becoming a star. "Act III: Awakening" follows Coodie reuiniting with Kanye during The Life Of Pablo era and follows him to end of the DONDA era.

title: Fade [V12]
description: Earliest known version with Post Malone, recorded after Charlie Handsome's version was picked by Ye and Rick Rubin to work on. While Charlie was working on his version, Post and Kanye were in another room writing idea's for the song, which is likely where most of the idea's on this version come from. Post Malone freestyles for around 16 minutes, and his vocals used in the released version are taken from this freestyle. Post Malone stated that "[we] went in the studio...we just recorded the scratch vocals and then I wrote over it". Same intro, chorus, bridge and first verse as the released version but in the part where Kanye says "I love to... I wanna... I'm tryna..." on the final version he is mumbling. Original snippet leaked November 7th, 2020.
